title: Positive weight Hermite and Legendre quadrature rules
abstract: arXiv:2609.26840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper contains new 80-digit positive-weight Gauss-Hermite and positive-weight interior-node Gauss-Legendre quadrature rules for up to five dimensions and varying polynomial degree accuracy (depending on quadrature type and dimension). Some of these rules improve on the best available rules in the literature and some offer rules where none (other than the tensor product) existed. The results were produced by combining methodology developed by previous researchers with new approaches. The full precision rules themselves are at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22881864. Software in Julia, Python, and R providing the rules is available via a package registry and/or GitHub: Quadriceps.jl (both 64-bit and 128-bit; https://github.com/NittanyLion/Quadriceps.jl), quadriceps-py (64-bit only; https://github.com/NittanyLion/quadriceps-py), and quadriceps-r (64-bit only; https://github.com/NittanyLion/quadriceps-r). translated_title: 正权重厄米特与勒让德求积法则
translated_abstract: 本文提出了新的80位精度正权重高斯-厄米特（Gauss-Hermite）求积法则以及正权重内节点高斯-勒让德（Gauss-Legendre）求积法则，适用于最高五维的情况，并具有不同的多项式精度阶数（取决于求积类型和维度）。其中一些法则改进了文献中现有最优的法则，另一些则提供了此前不存在（张量积方法除外）的法则。这些结果是将前人研究者开发的方法与新的方法相结合而得到的。完整的精确求积法则数据可在 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22881864 获取。提供这些求积法则的Julia、Python和R软件可通过包注册中心和/或GitHub获取：Quadriceps.jl（同时支持64位和128位；https://github.com/NittanyLion/Quadriceps.jl）、quadriceps-py（仅64位；https://github.com/NittanyLion/quadriceps-py）以及quadriceps-r（仅64位；https://github.com/NittanyLion/quadriceps-r）。用于创建的软件……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了适用于最高五维的80位精度正权重高斯-厄米特与内节点高斯-勒让德求积法则，部分法则优于现有文献中最优结果或填补了空白，并提供了Julia、Python和R的开源软件包。
en_tdlr: This paper presents new 80-digit positive-weight Gauss-Hermite and interior-node Gauss-Legendre quadrature rules for up to five dimensions, improving on or filling gaps in the best available rules, with accompanying open-source software in Julia, Python, and R.
